description: A PHP class 'ToolkitCommand' extending 'AbstractCommand' providing command-line tools for database integrity checks and repairs in the Goteo project, including project data, investments, pools, and blog comments.

classes.name: ToolkitCommand
classes.description: A command class for checking and repairing database issues in the Goteo project.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up the command name, description, options, arguments, and help text.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs various database checks and repairs based on the 'scope' argument, with optional 'update' flag to fix issues.
